title: Preserve Seeded Dialog Context Arguments
description: Fix EditorApp<E>/ViewerApp<E> APP_ID='surface' placeholder blocking button clicks across the entire application. VcsArtifactApp and related invocation checks compare app ID against instance surface ID instead of the static 'surface' placeholder.
summary: Investigated the shared dialog-submission path. The checked-out implementation already preserves seeded, non-form context arguments: effectiveActionArgs(defs, staged, seed) initializes from seed and resolves staged/default values only for declared fields; UIDialog supplies seedArgs. The Rust contract twin documents and implements the same rule. All other TypeScript callers omit seed, so none depend on filtering seeded keys. Focused validation passed: bun x nx run @semio-tech/framework:test -- --run glue.ts (2 files, 158 tests). No product files changed because the requested fix and regression coverage already exist.
